configuration.pdxLsPath.description: Path to the pdx-ls server binary. When empty, ParadoxCode checks the shared project config, the downloaded cache, and PATH.
configuration.serverVersion.description: Version tag used by the checksum-verified pdx-ls installer.
configuration.serverRepository.descripti: Release repository in owner/name form used by the pdx-ls installer.
configuration.serverInstallDirectory.des: Directory for checksum-verified pdx-ls downloads. Empty uses VS Code global storage.
configuration.projectConfig.description: Path to a .pdx/project.toml. When empty, ParadoxCode discovers it beside the workspace root so VS Code and Zed share project configuration.
configuration.modDirectory.description: Directory of the current Mod. Defaults to the workspace root.
configuration.vanillaIndexCache.descript: Path to a persistent Vanilla index cache (.pdxindex).
configuration.dependencies.description: Dependency Mods from lowest to highest priority. Each item is { id, path, index? }.
configuration.gameDirectory.description: EU4 installation root containing eu4.exe. Used to load mission textures.
configuration.diagnosticIgnoreCodes.desc: Diagnostic codes to hide in the VS Code Problems view.
configuration.diagnosticIgnoreFiles.desc: Workspace-relative diagnostic file globs to hide, for example **/README.txt.
configuration.diagnosticLogging.descript: Write diagnostic filtering counts to the ParadoxCode output channel.
configuration.preview.showTextures.descr: Use EU4 frame and icon textures when available in Mission Preview.
